families.construction: Fixed keyword presence scores; query +1 for a question mark, evidence +2 for URL, emotion +1 for >=2 exclamation marks; tie order evidence, deny, query, emotion, other; all-zero scores give other.
families.example: source_stance_type_deny: training-side one-hot indicator of source stance == deny
families.cutoff: source text for source stance; corresponding admitted prefix record for reaction types
families.fitting: fixed text rules; one-hot vocabulary from ranking training threads

families.construction: CHECKED/CSDC source publisher=user and source is_correction=False. PHEME verification maps to official; otherwise expert, media, official text cues in priority order, then user. Correction cues use denial/evidence/action wording; explicit adapter assignments override inferred flags. Supplied corrections are separate records.
families.cutoff: source descriptor or correction record admitted to the prefix; count/timestamp rules in the manuscript apply
families.fitting: fixed adapter/text rules; training-side categorical vocabulary

families.construction: Prefix counts, rates and response fractions; cascade adds nested windows, growth changes and censored first-event times.
families.cutoff: current or earlier observable windows; target and final counts excluded from feature assembly
families.fitting: deterministic counts; training-side scaling when used

families.construction: 6000-character assembled window, 128-token encoder, normalized mean-pooled embedding; cosine similarity to normalized prototypes; coordinate summaries.
families.cutoff: current-window texts in canonical record order
families.fitting: frozen pretrained MiniLM and fixed prototype sentences

inputs: records flagged as early correction candidates with elapsed time <= 6h
families.construction: Aggregate frozen post embeddings by thread. For each outer split, fit separate K-means models to source-post embeddings and six-hour thread-text embeddings from the outer training threads, using min(8, training-thread count) clusters, seed 42 and n_init=auto. Apply the training centroids to both training and held-out threads to obtain cluster labels and centroid distances.
families.cutoff: source-post summaries at each window; six-hour thread summaries admitted only at 6h/24h
families.fitting: K-means, ranker, categorical layout and scaling use outer training threads; the encoder is frozen.

families.construction: Disabled in the light configuration. Optional score columns are zero-filled when assembled.
families.cutoff: not an active descriptor in these runs
